description_en: Deletes an IP entry from an access control policy group
description_zh: 删除访问控制策略组中的IP条目
kebab_example: aliyun vpc remove-ipv6-translator-acl-list-entry --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --acl-id ipv6transacl-bp1de20000 --acl-entry-id ipv6transaclentry-bp105jrs0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveIPv6TranslatorAclListEntry

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The region of the access control policy group
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略组的地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access control policy group to which the access control policy entry belongs
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略条目所属的访问控制策略组ID
parameters.name: acl_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access control policy entry that you want to delete
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的访问控制策略条目ID
parameters.name: acl_entry_id
